hasuwini77-3d-logo-skill-3d-logo.description: Create a 3D spinning coin/medal effect from any logo image using React Three Fiber. Auto-detects the logo's outline, removes solid backgrounds (white, black or any flat colour), builds a chrome-rimmed coin that follows the exact logo shape, and adds environment reflections. Use when the user wants a 3D logo, spinning logo, rotating logo, coin effect, medal effect, logo animation, or mentions making a logo "3D" or "spin." Also trigger when user says "3d-logo", "spinning coin", "logo coin", "3D badge", or wants to turn a flat image into a premium 3D rotating element.
